purpose: Single source of brand/style truth for ANNA (the customer-facing product brand). Mirrors SOCC_DESIGN_CANON_V1 structure. Every ANNA surface (Telegram persona styling, landing, owner dashboard, any future channel) renders through this canon. Forged by Brand Forge from strategy core + D3 direction.
relation_to_socc: ANNA = product/FACE brand. SOCC = house/BRAINS brand (matrix-minimalism, internal). They are deliberately different — different audiences. ANNA inherits SOCC's VOICE-LAW discipline (honest, calm, no hype) but NOT its terminal aesthetic.

web_palette_hex.note: Light-first, warm. Sage trust-base + ONE warm sand accent. NOT terracotta.

typography.note: Humanist, warm. Body 16px min, line-height 1.5, tight tracking on headings.

logo.mark_meaning: две вложенные дуги = укрытие + человеческое тепло + спокойная точка

anna_specific.tone: warm, human, never robotic; care first, then task
anna_specific.stealth: ANNA presents as a human administrator; never self-discloses as a bot (creator ruling A); quality is the shield + graceful human handoff

adoption_rule.but: переодеваются в ANNA-канон (палитра D3/типографика/тон/стелс) → только потом в продукт
adoption_rule.never: ship raw external UI or any robotic/bot phrasing to patients

binds.anna_entity: future ANNA channels import this canon for all patient/owner surfaces

truth_boundary: ANNA design canon in REVIEW. Declares single brand/style law for ANNA (D3). Logo is an early iteration; patient-avatar under stealth unresolved; contrasts computed not tool-verified. Not sealed. No network, no revenue, no AGI.
